summary_md: **Shorya Mishra ([@SMishra61](https://x.com/SMishra61/status/2116212031141343676))** summarizes *DISCO* ([arXiv 2610.35957](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35957)), distributed speculative decoding that keeps a draft model server-side and sends only token IDs and scalar probabilities to cut bandwidth.

referenced_urls.title: Distributed LLM Inference via Communication-Efficient Speculative Decoding
